correctness.rationale: Verified the exact lax-splitting-to-outdegree-one-orientation equivalence; minimal failing teams are connected bicircular circuits, with e=v+1 and minimum degree two. Bipartite degree sums imply |a-b|≤1. K_(2,3) and K_(3,3) minus two disjoint edges are minimal theta circuits; each double subdivision preserves minimality while increasing each color part by one and edge count by two, achieving every size to the bound. Exact six- and seven-edge multiplicities counted. A standalone independent finite checker passed 4,952 direct semantic comparisons plus exhaustive minimal-falsifier spectra on rectangles through 4×4.

The six/seven minimal failure multiplicities make the smallest detection patterns enumerably precise. The distinction between at-most-h local tests and literal exactly-k coherence is a meaningful semantic boundary, not an arbitrary finite slice.
